rows.grounds: instrumental dual of a compound denoting sesame and clarified butter as oblation materials
direct object of the prescribed ritual action
predicate adjective marking the oblation as distinct
relative pronoun introducing the desired purpose
optative expressing the practitioner's intended aim

items.question: What distinct oblation with sesame and ghee may be performed for any desired purpose?
premises: An oblation should be performed using sesame and ghee.
This oblation is characterized as a separate rite.
The rite may be undertaken for whatever purpose one desires.
items.inference: The sesame-and-ghee oblation functions as a distinct optional rite adaptable to desired aims.
uncertainties: The precise scope of purposes covered by 'yat arthayet' is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should perform this oblation with sesame and ghee; it is a separate rite, to be done for whatever purpose one may desire.
